words: The explicit rewrite event overwrites already-landed Cottonwood gold days with the history_scope derived from the floor-day partition, so the landed days that carry the old constant can take the derived value. write_day takes a rewrite flag: with it the partition must already hold objects and the two keys are overwritten with no other write; an empty partition is refused before any put. run_day passes the flag and refuses a rewrite whose table lacks the history_scope_claim column before any put. The landing handler's rewrite event names a start and an end, is capped at MAX_BACKFILL_DAYS trading days, is limited to landed days, refuses every malformed or out-of-range request before any write, and honours dry_run. Nothing is deleted: the bucket is versioned and every prior version stays. The scheduled, day and days paths keep the no-overwrite guard. NOT PROVEN: nothing ran against S3, the Lambda function is not updated, and the rewrite of the landed days is a separate signed pair.
